question_vi: TypeScript với React: generics trong components là gì?
question_en: What are generics in React components in TypeScript?
answer_html_vi:
Generic components cho phép reuse component với nhiều kiểu data.

  • Trong .tsx cần disambiguate <T,> hoặc <T extends unknown> vì <T> bị hiểu là JSX tag.
  • TS 5.4+ thêm NoInfer<T> utility để kiểm soát inference tốt hơn.
typescript
function Select<T>({ options, value, onChange }: {
  options: T[];
  value: T;
  onChange: (v: T) => void;
}) {
  return <select>...</select>;
}
// Dùng:
<Select<User> options={users} value={selected} onChange={setSelected} />
answer_html_en:
Generic components let you reuse a component with multiple data types.

  • In .tsx files you must disambiguate <T,> or <T extends unknown> because <T> is parsed as a JSX tag.
  • TS 5.4+ adds NoInfer<T> utility for more control over inference.
typescript
function Select<T>({ options, value, onChange }: {
  options: T[];
  value: T;
  onChange: (v: T) => void;
}) {
  return <select>...</select>;
}
// Usage:
<Select<User> options={users} value={selected} onChange={setSelected} />
